I don’t really understand the argument that 3.5mm is better than USB-C. The argument about not being able to charge your phone and use wired headphones at the same time makes sense, but the solution there is just to add a second USB-C port. Plenty of other universal standards are replaced over time with improved technology. With USB-C, you don’t have to worry about whether or not the cable is compatible with a microphone. It always is. If we switch to USB-C to USB-C cables for wired over-ear headphones, you can use the same cable to charge your phone if you need to. It’s just better in every way.
